content:
Build a high-energy Neo-Brutalist developer platform website for "HYPERFORGE" — an edge computing and autonomous AI runtime.

# Design System & Style Tokens
Theme: Neo-Brutalist High Contrast (warm newsprint canvas, bold black borders, hard block shadows, zero corner radii).
- Canvas background: #fffbf0 (warm paper)
- Card surface: #ffffff (stark white)
- Dark surface / Contrast card: #121212 (ink black)
- Text primary: #000000
- Text secondary: #525252
- Text on dark: #ffffff
- Accent Yellow: #fde047
- Accent Cyan: #38bdf8
- Accent Coral: #fb7185
- Accent Lime: #4ade80
- Border: 3px solid #000000
- Box Shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000 (hover: 6px 6px 0px #000000)
- Border Radius: 0px (strictly sharp edges on all cards, buttons, badges, and inputs)
- Typography: Space Grotesk / Inter (heavy 800/900 weight display titles, monospace code snippets)

# Required Sections & Capabilities:
1. Header: Brand logo "HYPERFORGE // 0.9.4", navigation links ("Runtime", "Nodes", "Benchmarks", "Pricing"), status pill with pulsing green dot ("ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL"), interactive mobile menu toggle (useState), and a high-contrast "START CLUSTERING" CTA button.
2. Hero: High-voltage split hero. Left column: massive brutalist headline ("DEPLOY RAW COMPUTE TO THE BORDERLESS EDGE"), punchy description, interactive command-line snippet with a "Copy to Clipboard" button (useState), and primary CTA with hard shadow. Right column: interactive cluster node monitor card showing simulated real-time latency (ms), active pods, and throughput graphs.
3. Features: 3-column brutalist card grid with hard black shadows and sticker badges ("HOT", "ZERO COLD START", "WASM READY"). Include an interactive category tab filter (useState: "All", "Orchestration", "Security", "Latency") that switches highlighted capabilities.
4. Live Benchmarks & Interactive Calculator: Interactive RPS and Node slider (useState) where users adjust traffic sliders to calculate instantaneous latency savings and cost comparisons against legacy cloud providers.
5. Pricing: 3 tier cards ("Hobby / $0", "Developer / $29", "Enterprise / Custom") with a monthly vs. annual billing toggle (useState: 20% discount badge), feature checklists with bold checkmark badges, and hover lift effects.
6. FAQ: Interactive expandable accordion drawer (useState: click to expand/collapse question cards) answering common questions about deployment speeds, data isolation, and cold start benchmarks.
7. Footer: Marquee banner ribbon ("HYPERFORGE ENGINE — ZERO COLD STARTS — 100% DETERMINISTIC"), newsletter sign-up form with brutalist input box and submit button, social links, legal disclaimers, and node region status indicators.

summary:
